title: Preserved filing breakdown tables through AnalystContext
points: Filing requests for reported figures and breakdowns now retain numeric posture even when the user asks for a text search, and subsidiary cash-flow requests include the closest disclosed segment schedule in their typed retrieval contract.
Narrative lanes reject page-local claims that a whole report lacks a disclosure and reject quantitative rewrites whose number sequence is not aligned to a source row.
Invalid extraction output receives one bounded correction attempt and otherwise falls back to the raw filing page, with the intervention recorded in the stage ledger.
Analyst source excerpts now allocate the existing total character budget adaptively so high-priority structured schedules can arrive intact without increasing the overall context allowance.
Analyst answers surface the full relevant segment axis rather than cherry-picking rows when a source table provides a usable breakdown.

Regression coverage reproduces the ENGROH 2025 annual-report follow-up and requires the reported Fertilizer and Connectivity capital-expenditure figures while rejecting invented explicit-absence claims.
